# Barkskin (`spells:barkskin`)
**Level 2 [Transmutation](../magic-schools/transmutation.md)** | **Casting Time:** Bonus Action | **Range:** Touch
**Components:** V, S, M (a handful of bark) | **Duration:** 1 hour | **Classes:** [Druid](../classes/druid.md), [Ranger](../classes/ranger.md)

You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, the target's skin assumes a bark-like appearance, and the target has an Armor Class of 17 if its AC is lower than that.
